team.account: 2 pages. Evening hip stretch for after sitting, about 2 minutes: kneel and shift forward, hold 30 seconds a side, then finish with 30 seconds of pigeon pose on each side.

testerLines: console Yanni: send this to Maya for after tonight's reading
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: #168 lets founders send a file through ZOH.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH drafts a send_text card with the file and one line in its voice that matches the file (a short, about 2-minute hip stretch, the pigeon pose) and ties it to after tonight's chapter on the couch; it never invents a different length or content. It tells the founders in a line what the card will do and doesn't claim it's sent.
